title: Alum Cave Trail to Mount LeConte
map_label: A 3D walk up the Alum Cave Trail through the spruce-fir forest to LeConte Lodge.

stops.title: Alum Cave Trailhead
stops.alt: The Alum Cave Trail with a view over forested ridges.
stops.text: The route starts on Newfound Gap Road in Great Smoky Mountains National Park. The photo shows the trail higher up.

stops.file: Viewpoint along Alum Cave Trail ascending towards Mount LeConte, GSMNP, TN.jpg
stops.title: Viewpoint on the climb
stops.alt: A viewpoint on the Alum Cave Trail looking over the Smoky Mountains.
stops.text: Higher on the trail, breaks in the spruce-fir forest open views across the ridges.

stops.file: View atop Cliff Tops on Mount LeConte, GSMNP, TN.jpg
stops.title: LeConte Lodge
stops.alt: The view from Cliff Tops near LeConte Lodge.
stops.text: You have reached LeConte Lodge. Cliff Tops, a short walk away, looks out over the Smokies.
